edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer privileged control
constructor writes the owner state variable
addPlayer is guarded by onlyDiceRoll requiring msg.sender == diceRollAddress
createWinner is guarded by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == owner
seTJackpotPersent is guarded by onlyOwner
ownerPauseJackpot is guarded by onlyOwner
ownerSetdiceRollAddress is guarded by onlyOwner
ownerTransferEther is guarded by onlyOwner
block.timestamp is read into local tmNow
createWinner relies on block.timestamp, a miner-influenced value
nextJackpotTime = tmNow + 72000 creates timestamp dependency
createWinner invokes sendJackpot which performs the external payout
sendJackpot executes winner.transfer(amount) external value call
JackpotPeriods += 1 state update happens after the external transfer, enabling reentrant manipulation
ownerTransferEther executes sendTo.transfer(amount) external value call
sendTo parameter flows into the transfer recipient
amount parameter flows into the transfer value
winner parameter flows into winner.transfer recipient
amount parameter flows into winner.transfer value
rand() builds the seed from blockhash, coinbase and difficulty producing predictable randomness
previous seed state variable is consumed by the keccak256 randomness computation
rand() return value is used to derive the winner index
createWinner computes random = rand() % tempPlayer.length with unchecked arithmetic
the modulo result is stored in the local random index

selected winner is written into winnerHistory[JackpotPeriods]

createWinner writes the winner history entry
